title: Gallaudet sees the Go Fast video on the Navy Secret Network
place_text: Off the US East Coast (USS Theodore Roosevelt exercise); Navy Secret Network

tellings.quote: I was a onestar admiral and I saw on the Navy Secret Network the Go Fast video.

plain: A retired Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet says that in 2015, when he was a one-star admiral, he watched the Go Fast video on the Navy's classified computer network. That video is a Navy infrared recording of a small object racing low over the ocean, filmed during a training exercise off the US East Coast. Gallaudet tells it as something he saw himself, and he links it to a Navy fighter pilot named Ryan Graves, who flew in that exercise. The point of his story is that the video was being passed around inside the Navy long before anyone outside heard of it.
